Answers:
- Time blocks: we can run a split-block approach. Proposal: 4 hours PDT on Thu Aug 5 for the hands-on prompt review + structured-output guardrails session (interactive). Then a 2-hour routing/load window the following morning (Fri Aug 6) at 08:00 PDT for the main burst, followed by an overnight soak (automated replay) we’ll monitor. That gives EU stakeholders an afternoon overlap on Thu (~17:00 CEST).
- Load window: compressed 2-hour focused burst + overnight soak is our recommended pattern for this POC — avoids full-day churn while letting us iterate on batching/quantization knobs between runs.
- Redwood SRE primary: Ben Carter will be on-call for the runs and will handle bastion keys + Live Prometheus links. Ben — I’ll add you to the calendar invite and to the VPN pre-reqs thread.

Operational checklist (quick):
- BlueLeaf: confirm test accounts + sample prompt inventory (CSV) by EOD Wed Aug 4.
- Redwood: provide SSH bastion host + ephemeral user for the test cluster by 15:00 PDT Thu Aug 5.
- All: shared evaluation doc for structured output pass/fail criteria (I attached routing-scenarios.md).

I attached a simple routing matrix and the timing grid — if that looks good I’ll send the calendar invites and a short runbook.
